title: A team note shapes the reply but is never quoted or credited
origin: Issue #196 (coverage gap: a team note that is never quoted)

history.text: Morning Priya! 15 minutes in the living room at 7: squats, push-ups, plank. You in?

plan.step: 15 min bodyweight circuit: squats, push-ups, plank
plan.reason: Short and at home, so it fits before work.

team.body: Her dad is in hospital this week, so she's stretched thin. Go gentle on misses.

testerLines: honestly couldn't do it this morning, was at the hospital with my dad till late
yeah thanks. I'll try tonight maybe
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: no case checked that a team note stays unquoted.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers what she said first, with real warmth about her dad, and no push in that text beyond, at most, a gentle no-pressure mention of a smaller version. It never says the team, the founders, a note or that it already knew about the hospital: what it knows comes only from what she just said. Her "I'll try tonight maybe" gets a light, kind reply (a smaller version is fine as an offer, never a guilt trip), still with no mention of the team or the note.
